tasks.name: Land on dashboard and grasp purpose
tasks.exit_state: User sees animated heatmap, headline metric, mode badge within 2s
happy_path: Browser hits http://localhost:3000
App boots in Mock mode by default (auto-select)
Skeleton renders within 200ms
WebSocket connects, first frame paints
Headline metric (e.g., '1,247 attendees, 72% capacity') appears top-left
Mode badge ('MOCK -- simulated data') visible top-right
Heatmap animates with synthetic crowd movement
failure_modes: Docker not running -> show terminal hint
Port 3000 conflict -> dev script prints alternate URL
WebSocket fails -> banner 'connection issue, retrying...' + skeleton persists, never blank

tasks.name: Switch data mode
tasks.exit_state: Active mode is Replay/Live/Mesh; badge updated; heatmap reflects new source
happy_path: User clicks mode chip in header
Dropdown shows 4 options with availability indicator (green dot = ready, gray = unavailable)
User selects Replay
Crossfade transition (300ms) instead of white flash
Mode badge color/label updates immediately
Replay scenario picker slides in below header
failure_modes: Live mode selected but no sensors detected -> show 'No sensors found' + auto-fallback option
Mesh gateway offline -> mode chip greyed with tooltip 'Gateway not reachable'
Replay file missing -> show scenario picker with 'Sample scenarios' fallback list

tasks.name: Inspect a zone's occupancy and trend
tasks.exit_state: Zone detail panel open with numeric count, % capacity, 5-min trend sparkline
happy_path: User clicks a zone polygon (or hot spot) on the map
Zone polygon highlights with thicker outline
Right-side panel slides in (or bottom sheet on smaller viewports)
Panel shows: zone name, current count, % capacity, trend arrow, sparkline, alerts for this zone
Optional: 'Set capacity threshold' control (Operator-only affordance, hidden in Spectator)
failure_modes: Zone has no recent data -> show 'Awaiting sensor reports' with last-seen timestamp
Sparkline data sparse -> show dots instead of line, label '< 5min of data'

tasks.name: Replay a recorded scenario
tasks.exit_state: Scenario plays back at chosen speed with scrubber visible
happy_path: Scenario picker shows 4 default scenarios with thumbnail
User picks 'Concert exit rush'
Player loads (skeleton 400ms), scrubber appears at bottom
Playback starts at 1x; user can adjust speed (0.25x .. 4x)
Heatmap updates from recorded event stream
User can scrub backwards to inspect a specific moment
failure_modes: Scenario file corrupt -> show 'Unable to load scenario' + list other scenarios
Scrubber jitter at high speed -> auto-cap speed at 4x and warn

tasks.name: View and dismiss an alert
tasks.exit_state: Alert marked acknowledged (visual only in MVP); panel collapses or shows next
happy_path: Alert appears in panel with severity badge (info/warn/critical), zone link, timestamp
Toast briefly surfaces critical alerts (auto-dismiss 6s)
User clicks alert -> highlights zone on map + opens zone detail
User clicks 'Acknowledge' -> alert greys out, moves to bottom
Counter updates: '1 active, 3 acknowledged'
failure_modes: No alerts active -> panel shows 'No active alerts -- system nominal' (not blank)
Alert source zone removed -> show 'Source no longer tracked' instead of broken link

tasks.name: View sensor topology + drill into a sensor
tasks.exit_state: Topology tab open; sensor selected with raw event tail visible
happy_path: User clicks topology icon (collapsible to keep Spectator view clean)
Right-side panel becomes Topology tab
Map switches overlay: sensors rendered as nodes with health color (green/amber/red)
Coverage gaps highlighted with diagonal hatch pattern
User clicks a sensor node
Sensor detail: id, type (BLE/WiFi/Mesh), last-seen, RSSI sample, raw event tail (last 10 events)
failure_modes: No sensors in Mock -> show 8 simulated nodes with 'mock' badge
Live mode 0 sensors -> empty state: 'No sensors discovered. Check BLE permissions.' + diagnostic link

tasks.name: Reset demo timeline without reload
tasks.exit_state: Mock timeline reset to t=0, alerts cleared, badge unchanged
happy_path: User presses R key (or clicks discreet reset icon in header)
Confirmation toast: 'Reset demo timeline' (auto-dismiss 2s)
Heatmap fades to t=0 state in 400ms
Alerts panel clears, returns to 'No active alerts -- system nominal'
Mock event sequence restarts; 90s alert re-armed
failure_modes: Reset triggered while in Live mode -> confirm modal: 'Live mode -- reset disconnects current sensors. Continue?'
WebSocket reconnect needed -> brief 'reconnecting' state then resume

tasks.name: Recover when Live or Mesh fails mid-demo
tasks.exit_state: User aware of failure, has options (retry, fallback, dismiss)
happy_path: Sensor reports stop for > 30s
Mode badge gains warning ring + tooltip 'Sensor stream stalled'
Toast offers: 'Switch to Replay (last 5min cached) | Retry Live | Dismiss'
User picks Replay -> seamless transition using cached buffer
failure_modes: Cached buffer empty -> offer Mock fallback explicitly
User dismisses without action -> dashboard continues with last-known state + persistent stale-data indicator
